facts.business: Gujarat Containers Limited manufactures containers, likely metal containers given raw materials like iron and steel.
key_risks: Availability and price volatility of raw materials, particularly Iron & Steel
High input costs such as freight and electricity
Frequent fluctuation in raw material prices
Loss or impairment of key supplier relationships
Commodity price risk and foreign exchange risk for imported raw materials
facts.related_party_note: Security deposit of Rs. 10.00 lacs given to Management Aids (related party) as rent deposit against properties.
